history.sql:
WITH 字段提取 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(fields->'分公司') = 'array' THEN fields->'分公司'->0->>'text' ELSE fields->>'分公司' END AS 分公司,
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(fields->'代表处') = 'array' THEN fields->'代表处'->0->>'text' ELSE fields->>'代表处' END AS 代表处,
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(fields->'业务代表') = 'array' THEN fields->'业务代表'->0->>'text' ELSE fields->>'业务代表' END AS 业务代表,
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(fields->'总任务（金额）') = 'array' THEN fields->'总任务（金额）'->0->>'text' ELSE fields->>'总任务（金额）' END AS 任务原始,
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(fields->'年度开单金额') = 'array' THEN fields->'年度开单金额'->0->>'text' ELSE fields->>'年度开单金额' END AS 开单原始,
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(fields->'当前年') = 'array' THEN fields->'当前年'->0->>'text' ELSE fields->>'当前年' END AS 当前年
    FROM angel_group_data
),
基础数据 AS (
    SELECT
        分公司, 代表处, 业务代表,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(任务原始, '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), ''), '0')::NUMERIC AS 任务金额,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(开单原始, '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), ''), '0')::NUMERIC AS 开单金额,
        CASE WHEN 分公司 LIKE '%分公司' THEN '区域条线' WHEN 分公司 LIKE '%业务部' THEN '行业条线' ELSE '事业部层级' END AS 条线类型
    FROM 字段提取 WHERE 当前年 = '2026'
),
维度汇总 AS (
    -- 代表处：排除业务员明细行
    SELECT '区域条线' AS 条线, 分公司 AS 上级名称, 代表处 AS 节点名称, '代表处' AS 层级, 任务金额, 开单金额 
    FROM 基础数据 WHERE 条线类型='区域条线' AND 分公司='东部分公司' AND 代表处<>'' AND (业务代表 IS NULL OR 业务代表='')
    UNION ALL
    -- 业务代表：直接取数
    SELECT '区域条线', 分公司, 业务代表, '业务代表', 任务金额, 开单金额 
    FROM 基础数据 WHERE 条线类型='区域条线' AND 分公司='东部分公司' AND 业务代表<>''
)
SELECT
    条线, 层级, 节点名称, 上级名称,
    SUM(任务金额) AS 总任务金额,
    SUM(开单金额) AS 年度开单金额,
    CASE WHEN SUM(任务金额)>0 THEN ROUND(SUM(开单金额)/SUM(任务金额)*100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS 达成率,
    ROUND(SUM(任务金额)-SUM(开单金额), 2) AS 剩余任务金额
FROM 维度汇总
WHERE 上级名称 = '东部分公司' OR 节点名称 = '东部分公司'
GROUP BY 条线, 层级, 节点名称, 上级名称
UNION ALL
-- 东部分公司总计
SELECT '区域条线','分公司','东部分公司',NULL,SUM(任务金额),SUM(开单金额),
    CASE WHEN SUM(任务金额)>0 THEN ROUND(SUM(开单金额)/SUM(任务金额)*100, 2) ELSE 0 END,
    ROUND(SUM(任务金额)-SUM(开单金额), 2)
FROM 基础数据
WHERE 分公司='东部分公司' AND (代表处 IS NULL OR 代表处='') AND (业务代表 IS NULL OR 业务代表='')
ORDER BY 条线 DESC, 层级 DESC, 上级名称
LIMIT 100;

WITH base AS (

        d.id,
        d.fields,

                CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.fields->'事业部') = 'array' 
                    THEN d.fields->'事业部'->0->>'text' 
                    ELSE d.fields->>'事业部' END
            ), ''), '商用事业部'
        ) AS syb,
        
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(
                CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.fields->'分公司') = 'array' 
                    THEN d.fields->'分公司'->0->>'text' 
                    ELSE d.fields->>'分公司' END
            ), ''), ''
        ) AS fgs,
        
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(
                CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.fields->'代表处') = 'array' 
                    THEN d.fields->'代表处'->0->>'text' 
                    ELSE d.fields->'代表处' END
            ), ''), ''
        ) AS dbc,
        
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(
                CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.fields->'业务代表') = 'array' 
                    THEN d.fields->'业务代表'->0->>'text' 
                    ELSE d.fields->'业务代表' END
            ), ''), ''
        ) AS ywdb,
        
        -- 金额字段解析
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_replace(
                    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.fields->'总任务（金额）') = 'array' 
                        THEN d.fields->'总任务（金额）'->0->>'text' 
                        ELSE d.fields->>'总任务（金额）' END,
                    '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'
                ), ''
            )::NUMERIC, 0
        ) AS task,
        
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_replace(
                    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.fields->'年度开单金额') = 'array' 
                        THEN d.fields->'年度开单金额'->0->>'text' 
                        ELSE d.fields->>'年度开单金额' END,
                    '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'
                ), ''
            )::NUMERIC, 0
        ) AS sales,
        
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_replace(
                    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.fields->'待分配金额') = 'array' 
                        THEN d.fields->'待分配金额'->0->>'text' 
                        ELSE d.fields->'待分配金额' END,
                    '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'
                ), ''
            )::NUMERIC, 0
        ) AS pending_task
        
    FROM angel_group_data d
    WHERE d.fields IS NOT NULL
),

-- 区域条线识别
region_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fgs,
        dbc,
        task,
        sales,
        pending_task,
        CASE 
            WHEN dbc <> '' THEN '代表处'
            WHEN fgs <> '' THEN '分公司'
            ELSE '事业部'
        END AS level
    FROM base
    WHERE fgs LIKE '%分公司%'
),

-- 行业条线识别
industry_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fgs,
        ywdb,
        task,
        sales,
        pending_task,
        CASE 
            WHEN ywdb <> '' THEN '业务代表'
            WHEN fgs <> '' THEN '行业部'
            ELSE '事业部'
        END AS level
    FROM base
    WHERE fgs LIKE '%业务部%'
),

-- ===============================
-- 图表1：事业部总体达成率趋势（模拟月度）
-- ===============================
exec_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        '全事业部' AS unit,
        SUM(task) AS total_task,
        SUM(sales) AS total_sales,
        SUM(pending_task) AS total_pending,
        ROUND(SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(task), 0) * 100, 2) AS completion_rate,
        ROUND(SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(task) + SUM(pending_task), 0) * 100, 2) AS overall_progress
    FROM base
    WHERE fgs <> ''
),

-- ===============================
-- 图表2：四大分公司达成率对比
-- ===============================
fgs_perf AS (
    SELECT 
        fgs AS unit,
        SUM(task) AS task,
        SUM(sales) AS sales,
        ROUND(SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(task), 0) * 100, 2) AS completion_rate
    FROM region_data
    WHERE level = '分公司'
    GROUP BY fgs
),

-- ===============================
-- 图表3：各分公司Top2/Bottom2代表处
-- ===============================
dbc_perf AS (
    SELECT 
        fgs,
        dbc,
        task,
        sales,
        ROUND(SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(task), 0) * 100, 2) AS completion_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fgs ORDER BY sales DESC) AS top_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fgs ORDER BY sales ASC) AS bottom_rank
    FROM region_data
    WHERE level = '代表处' AND dbc <> ''
    GROUP BY fgs, dbc, task, sales
),

-- ===============================
-- 图表4：三大行业线达成率+贡献比
-- ===============================
industry_perf AS (
    SELECT 
        fgs AS unit,
        SUM(task) AS task,
        SUM(sales) AS sales,
        ROUND(SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(task), 0) * 100, 2) AS completion_rate,
        ROUND(SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / 
            (SELECT NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) FROM industry_data WHERE level = '行业部') * 100, 2) AS contribution_pct
    FROM industry_data
    WHERE level = '行业部'
    GROUP BY fgs
),

-- ===============================
-- 图表5：各行业线Top5王牌代表
-- ===============================
rep_perf AS (
    SELECT 
        fgs AS industry,
        ywdb AS rep,
        SUM(task) AS task,
        SUM(sales) AS sales,
        ROUND(SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ywdb), 0), 2) AS per_capita_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fgs ORDER BY SUM(sales) DESC) AS rep_rank
    FROM industry_data
    WHERE level = '业务代表' AND ywdb <> ''
    GROUP BY fgs, ywdb
),

-- ===============================
-- 图表6：待分配任务金额占比
-- ===============================
pending_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(fgs, '未分配') AS unit,
        SUM(pending_task) AS pending,
        ROUND(SUM(pending_task)::NUMERIC / 
            (SELECT SUM(pending_task) FROM base) * 100, 2) AS pending_pct
    FROM base
    GROUP BY fgs
),

-- ===============================
-- 图表7：异常预警（达成率<10%）
-- ===============================
low_perf_warning AS (
    SELECT 
        '区域' AS track,
        fgs AS parent,
        dbc AS unit,
        task,
        sales,
        ROUND(SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(task), 0) * 100, 2) AS completion_rate
    FROM region_data
    WHERE level = '代表处' AND task > 0
    GROUP BY fgs, dbc, task, sales
    HAVING SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / SUM(task) < 0.10
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        '行业' AS track,
        fgs AS parent,
        ywdb AS unit,
        task,
        sales,
        ROUND(SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(task), 0) * 100, 2) AS completion_rate
    FROM industry_data
    WHERE level = '业务代表' AND task > 0
    GROUP BY fgs, ywdb, task, sales
    HAVING SUM(sales)::NUMERIC / SUM(task) < 0.10
)

-- ===============================
-- 输出结果
-- ===============================
-- 1. 事业部总体看板
SELECT 'exec_summary' AS query_type, * FROM exec_summary
UNION ALL
-- 2. 四大分公司达成率
SELECT 'fgs_perf' AS query_type, * FROM fgs_perf
UNION ALL
-- 3. 代表处业绩（Top/Bottom）
SELECT 'dbc_perf' AS query_type, * FROM dbc_perf
WHERE top_rank <= 2 OR bottom_rank <= 2
UNION ALL
-- 4. 三大行业线达成率
SELECT 'industry_perf' AS query_type, * FROM industry_perf
UNION ALL
-- 5. 各行业线Top5代表
SELECT 'rep_perf' AS query_type, * FROM rep_perf
WHERE rep_rank <= 5
UNION ALL
-- 6. 待分配金额
SELECT 'pending_analysis' AS query_type, * FROM pending_analysis
UNION ALL
-- 7. 异常预警
SELECT 'low_perf_warning' AS query_type, * FROM low_perf_warning;

                    CASE 
                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->'年度开单金额') = 'array' 
                        THEN data->'年度开单金额'->0->>'text'
                        ELSE data->>'年度开单金额'
                    END,
                    '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'
                ), 
                ''
            ), 
            '0'
        )::NUMERIC AS sales,
        
        -- 条线分类（使用修正后的字段提取）
        CASE 
            WHEN (CASE 
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->'分公司') = 'array' 
                    THEN data->'分公司'->0->>'text'
                    ELSE data->>'分公司'
                  END) LIKE '%分公司' THEN '区域条线'
            WHEN (CASE 
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->'分公司') = 'array' 
                    THEN data->'分公司'->0->>'text'
                    ELSE data->>'分公司'
                  END) LIKE '%业务部' THEN '行业条线'
            ELSE '事业部层级'
        END as track_type
        
    FROM angel_group_data 
    WHERE 
     (CASE 
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->'当前年') = 'array' 
            THEN data->'当前年'->0->>'text'
            ELSE data->>'当前年'
           END) = '2026'
),

dimension_data AS (
    -- 区域条线 - 代表处层级
    SELECT '区域条线' as track, fgs as parent_name, dbc as name, '代表处' as level, task, sales
    FROM base_data 
    WHERE track_type = '区域条线' AND dbc IS NOT NULL AND dbc <> ''
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 区域条线 - 分公司层级
    SELECT '区域条线' as track, '商用事业部' as parent_name, fgs as name, '分公司' as level, task, sales
    FROM base_data 
    WHERE track_type = '区域条线' AND (dbc IS NULL OR dbc = '')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 行业条线 - 业务代表层级
    SELECT '行业条线' as track, fgs as parent_name, ywdb as name, '业务代表' as level, task, sales
    FROM base_data 
    WHERE track_type = '行业条线' AND ywdb IS NOT NULL AND ywdb <> ''
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 行业条线 - 业务部层级
    SELECT '行业条线' as track, '商用事业部' as parent_name, fgs as name, '业务部' as level, task, sales
    FROM base_data 
    WHERE track_type = '行业条线' AND (ywdb IS NULL OR ywdb = '')
)

-- 主查询：各维度汇总
SELECT 
    track, 
    level, 
    name, 
    parent_name,
    SUM(task) AS total_task,
    SUM(sales) AS annual_sales,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(task) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(sales) / SUM(task) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS completion_rate
FROM dimension_data
GROUP BY track, level, name, parent_name

UNION ALL

-- 事业部总计
SELECT 
    '全事业部' as track,
    '事业部' as level,
    '商用事业部' as name,
    NULL as parent_name,
    SUM(task) as total_task,
    SUM(sales) as annual_sales,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(task) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(sales) / SUM(task) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) 
        ELSE 0 
    END as completion_rate
FROM base_data
WHERE 
    (fgs IS NOT NULL AND fgs <> '') 
    AND (dbc IS NULL OR dbc = '') 
    AND (ywdb IS NULL OR ywdb = '')

ORDER BY track DESC, level DESC, parent_name;
